newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish PM backs doubts on EU forming federation.
newsitem.headline: Swedish PM backs doubts on EU forming federation.

text.p: Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson said on Tuesday that Riksbank Governor Urban Backstrom could be right in his assessment there was no risk of the European Union (EU) developing into a federation.
"Backstrom may be right in his judgement. I have never had any reason to doubt him while he has been governor of the Riksbank," Persson said at an industry conference.
"But I am waiting for several statements by leading European politicians, especially of Germany and France."
Backstrom said last week there was little risk of the EU developing into a federal union.
"A small country can block such a thing developing," Backstrom told a seminar on Friday.
"A decision on the EU developing into a supranational organ can only be taken by a full majority. There is widespread scepticism about the EU developing into a federation," Backstrom said earlier.
